title: Item 3: boundary layer and separation discovery (raw runs)

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

temperature.definition: fringe and plate kT; local kT measured (A-03)

geometry: periodic channel: fringe (inflow conditioning) → specular lead-in → diffuse flat plate in a specular floor; specular ceiling with optional smooth diffuser/contraction (A-19, A-20)
wallModel: segmented planar floor (Maxwell accommodation on the plate), specular ceiling plane and ceiling bodies

reynolds.note: Computed by the report script from measured quantities (EXTERNAL COMPARISON only).

mach.note: Computed by the report script (EXTERNAL COMPARISON only).

emptySpace.note: Master prompt §20: occupancy and density extremes on cells of ~40 particles; a cell below 0.1 φ_mean in 5 consecutive samples flags POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE. Low density near open boundaries (A-18) is expected and is not near-zero occupancy.

uncertainty.note: Seed ensembles; computed by the report script.

convergence.note: Judged by the report script across groups.
